         'dir yang gzung cha phyi rol pa bden na bden te legs shes pa dang dngos po tha dad du song bas <rs type="school">nyan thos bye brag tu smra ba</rs>'i lugs gcig byung la | brdzun na brdzun te legs shes pa dang gcig <pb n="23"/> pa bkag pa'i tha dad du song bas rnam brdzun pa'i grub mtha' gcig byung bas khyed sems tsam rnam bcas dgag pa la mi 'khrul lo zhes sun 'byin yang des nyes par mi 'gyur te | du mar thal ba 'dod thog la khyed rang gis spyi gcig tu khas blangs pas bsal ba yin gyi | spyi gcig dang gzung cha phyi rol pa rang rig gi shugs la grub pa ni don spyi  yin la de rtog bcas kyi shes pa dang bdag gcig par 'dod pas so  zhes <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3864">byang skyabs</rs> gsung so ||</seg></TEI>
